Attach land-cover composition to an AOI

attach_landuse.Rd

Extracts ESA WorldCover land-cover classes from GeoTIFF tiles covering an AOI, computes per-class proportions, rollups (green, blue, grey fractions), Shannon diversity, and joins them back to the input data. All fractions are area-weighted in square meters, ensuring comparability across latitudes and AOI sizes.

Usage

attach_landuse(
  df,
  out_dir = NULL,
  deduplicate = TRUE,
  crs_planar = 3857,
  include_cropland = FALSE,
  prefix = "lc_",
  progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

df

A data object carrying the AOI (produced by mutate_aoi_*()). Must contain an AOI identifier column and have an attached AOI geometry.

out_dir

Directory where WorldCover GeoTIFF files are located. Used if no recorded tiles are found in attr(df, "worldcover_tiles").

deduplicate

Logical. If TRUE (default), AOIs with identical geometry are extracted only once, then mapped back.

crs_planar

EPSG code of the projected CRS used to compute surface areas in meters. Defaults to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857).

include_cropland

Logical. If TRUE, cropland (class 40) is included in the "green+" rollup.

prefix

Prefix for output column names. Default is "lc_".

progress

Logical. If TRUE (default), show progress messages during extraction.

Value

The input df, augmented with land-cover composition columns.

Details

  • AOI handling: The AOI is validated and transformed to crs_planar to ensure that surface area is measured in square meters.

  • Summaries: Each land-cover class is weighted by its overlap area (m²).

  • Output: Per-class proportion columns (e.g. lc_10, lc_20), rollups (frac_green_core, frac_green_plus, frac_blue, frac_grey), and shannon diversity.

Attributes

Attributes of df are preserved. AOI and fetch metadata (e.g., attr(df, "traktr_aoi"), attr(df, "worldcover_tiles")) remain available.

See also

attach_ndvi, mutate_aoi_h3, mutate_aoi_buffer, fetch_landuse

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df <- mutate_aoi_buffer(my_points, dist = 100)
df <- fetch_landuse(df, out_dir = "data/worldcover", year = 2021, version = "v200")
df <- attach_landuse(df, out_dir = "data/worldcover", crs_planar = 3857)

# Inspect composition
head(df[, c("aoi_id", "frac_green_core", "shannon")])
} # }
